description: Nigeria - Aggregated Poverty map is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Demographics", published or maintained by KTH Royal Institute of Technology in Stockholm. This dataset is created based on a Nigeria's 1km Poverty map provided by worldpop.org. Data have been aggregated to local government areas level. Coverage: Nigeria. It has 1 file in CSV. The portal files it under Demographics. The portal gives 2013 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
